_comment: Wires hung between two points. chunk_size: metres; spans are cut into pieces no longer than this and drawn as one mesh per chunk and detail step, so hundreds of spans cost a few draw calls. max_span: metres; longer spans are refused as a mistake. build_ms_per_frame: milliseconds a frame may spend rebuilding changed chunks (at least one a frame); the rest wait for the next frames. sides: faces around each wire. min_pixels: a wire is never drawn thinner than this many pixels, so far lines don't flicker away. roughness: how matt the wires are. fade: metres over which one detail step fades into the next. lod: detail steps by distance from the camera to the middle of a chunk, each drawn until `until` metres (keep every `until` less `fade` at least 1.21 chunk sizes, or the nearest wire in a chunk can drop a step too close); `detail` scales the segments (1 = every segment), `barbs` draws barbed wire's barbs. kinds: per wire kind, `thickness` (metres across), `colour` ([r, g, b]), `sag` (how far the middle of a span hangs below the straight line, as a share of the span's length), `segment_length` (metres per segment at full detail), and for barbed wire `barbs`: `spacing` (metres between barbs), `length` (metres tip to tip) and `thickness`.
